author: Adrian Collins
description:
Look, I am a sucker for steampunk sci-fantasy, an angry FMC, opinionated sentient objects, queer chaos, and lots of emotional damage, so when Bill Adams promised all of that and more in The Godsblood Tragedy, I knew I was going to love it. This story is just absolutely epic in every sense of the word […]
